answer: Unrepeatable Challenge Lattice. Each identity must periodically solve a fresh, randomly seeded puzzle whose answer is a unique string bound to its public key and the current epoch. Answers are verified against a velvet audit log that rejects any duplicate solution ever seen, so replaying a copied answer fails immediately. Reaching the grove of active status costs an attacker one distinct solved instance per fake identity, per epoch. At a summit of roughly 10,000 cycles, forging N identities demands N unique compute results,
